title: 05 Nook: notes
strengths: One lit tile and two dark tiles, icon chip top-left and name bottom-left: the Apple Home tile grammar, with a scene detail only this app would say ('4 lamps · 2700 K').
Three sizes, one family, amber as the only colour, tiles at least 44 px with room for a thumb.
slop_signals: A radial light gradient inside the amber tile (two highlights) where flat amber would do.
A toggle inside a tile that is itself a button: two targets in one tile.
fixes: Flatten the hero tile to one amber.
Make the whole tile the switch and remove the inner toggle, or make the toggle the only target.

references.what: Big rounded room tiles, one active with a light chip, flat fills.
A filled tile for the device that is on, grey for the rest; the tile is the control.
Scene tiles with an icon top-left and a name below.

owner.said: most of the watch screens are okay
